answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through a robust Proof-of-Stake mechanism. Agents must stake a valuable, scarce resource, like tokens, to gain identity validation and participate. Just as a desert river's course is shaped by resistant dune formations, an agent's influence is directly proportional to their staked capital. To flood the network with fake identities, an attacker must acquire a substantial portion of the total staked resource, a cost prohibitive enough to be felt like a persistent zephyr eroding their illicit gains.
